source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
Some cards follow a normal scoring condition with labelled ones:

- ‘Cumulative’: meeting it pays its own VP plus the normal condition's VP.
- ‘Or’: only one condition pays, either the normal one or one alternative.

cumulative.requires: labelled condition following a standard condition is met

or.requires: one or more labelled alternatives follow a standard condition
awards: standard condition VP or one alternative VP
